steps.name: A gift for the leader (1)
steps.objective: First, talk to [Ren] in 「Avalon」, defeat [Zisk Territory Algoa] in 「Zisk Territory」 to obtain <Zisk Blueberry>, and defeat [Narke of Despair] in 「Icicle Prison」 to obtain <Kali Blueberry>. Then return to [Ren] in “Avalon.”

lines.text: (In a quiet alley of Avalon, Ren stands guard towards an invisible target obscured by sand fog.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Who is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Len, it's me. %s.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It was Adventurer. I was a little wary because it felt like a strong being had appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said so. Were you scouting?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yes, Frozen is looking inside Avalon, and I am looking this way. By the way, Adventurer, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I wanted to see Avalon again.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: You said so. I was a little disappointed that we couldn't eat together. I guess your conversation with Iris ended well, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thanks to you, it ended well. I'm back in Avalon, but there's really nothing here.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Even so, you have no choice but to be careful because you don't know what will happen or how. Ah, Adventurer. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on? Is it a big deal?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It's not a big deal. Media gave me a recipe for Cali traditional liquor, but I need Adventurer's help to make it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can make it?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Medea wanted to give the traditional Kali liquor to her teacher as a gift, but she said that she couldn't make it herself because she had used up a lot of her strength due to this incident.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: So he gave me the recipe and said it would be good if I made it instead... . He said he had to go to Lapeer.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Can you help me? sorry. Because I can't go to Lapier... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rapier… . are you okay. I also received a lot of help from Jis Card, so I will help you.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Thank you. If Adventurer makes it and gives it to Master, I don't think Yuran will say anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does Yuran hate Jiscard drinking so much?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: It doesn't mean anything, it just tells you to take care of your health. Teacher, if you drink like that, you will often turn your back on the world before Weiss.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: But these days, you don't eat as much for as long as before. This time, I just ate it with Baldrick without stopping for about two days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … After all, superhumans are different.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Mediah was also worried and gave me a recipe for just one bottle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. What are the ingredients?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: These are Cali blueberries and Zisk blueberries.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I think you can find it in Icicle Prison and Jisk Territory. Since blueberries are so special, you can't help but find them in nature.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I'll prepare the rest of the ingredients, so please come back here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

steps.name: A gift for the leader (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] at “God’s Tree Lapier” and obtain <Kali Traditional Wine>. Then, go to [Jisk Card] in “Jisk Territory.”

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Adventurer, here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought blueberries here. But these… .
(In front of Ren, there is a large container and a lot of bags containing what appears to be food ingredients.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I was a little careful because I was going to give it to my teacher. By the way, I think it smells nice because of the blueberries Adventurer brought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right? I didn't know the scent would be this strong... .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I think it's more because Avalon has nothing left. Oh, can you give me the ingredients?
(Ren takes the blueberries and puts them in a large container, then takes out one blueberry.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Is Tariel still here? There's nothing here now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tariel? It's a goose spirit that was chasing us around in a creepy way not long ago.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: %s As you know, spirits reside in basically everything in the world.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: There are spirits in elements such as fire, water, earth, wind, parts of nature such as stones, flowers, and trees, and even in chairs and dishes that we use at home.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: They are everywhere because they work for life. Anyway, such a spirit causing harm to people or life... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It may have been contaminated by a bad power or influenced by something stronger than a spirit.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Now that the bad power is gone, this place should go back to normal. Still, Adventurer brought fruit with clear energy... .

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Oh, the explanation was long, right? I've learned something at the church, so I'm planning to work alongside it. For Avalon... .
(Ren gently drops blueberries on the previously dug ground and prays. And as he prays in front of him, the sound of geese crowing is heard from somewhere.
Tight. Tight. Tight.
(The goose's face disappears and reappears repeatedly among the accumulated sand. Then, it approaches the hole where Len dropped it, picks up a blueberry, and begins to shake it.)
Tight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tariel looks happy.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I think you like it.
Tight. Tight, tight.
(Tariel continues to nod as if greeting Ren. Then, holding the blueberry in her arms, she runs forward and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I don't know how long it will take, but if Tariel works hard, there will be delicious blueberries in Avalon.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Then, let’s get started.
(Ren puts the ingredients he brought into a container, mixes them with a large ladle, and soon puts them into a large bottle.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: This is the end. Now, take it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Just hold this and shake it at the top of Lapier. About 3 minutes, like dancing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is that really okay?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: That's what it says in the recipe Medea gave me, so please trust me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. When you're done, can I bring it back to Ren?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I think you can bring it to the teacher right away. And if you get hungry on the go, eat it. This is ciabatta made in the style of the Ceres Order.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Len. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those things in the bread are raisins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is it okay to make it like this, even though it is a traditional Kali liquor? It sure smells good... .
(Climbing to the top of Lapier with the cool wind as your friend, you can feel the clean air, which is definitely different from the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air here is definitely different from the ground. Come to think of it, I faced Requiem here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has time already passed that much?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, let’s shake the bottle without thinking about anything else. Just like dancing as Ren said... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anyone looking here?
(There are no people, but there are several Lapier phantom beasts chasing Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, you guys. Please pretend not to know. I said it would take about 3 minutes, so let's do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… ?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's true. The color changed? Has it matured at all? I think it worked... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tractus, don't clap! Don’t even dance along!

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I saw Jenna too, so I should go back. Oh, %s? What's going on here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jiscard.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's only been a few days, but it's nice to see you again. So, did your conversation with Iris end well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, the story ended well.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: … Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: We will continue to be here for everyone as we are.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There are still beings that threaten everyone, so the path we must take will become even more difficult.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Of course, big things will continue to happen to you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you for answering that it's okay... . You want to be good for those who believe in you and believe in you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: … And %s, take care of yourself first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will take Jiscard’s words to heart.
(Giscard thinks for a moment about %s’s answer.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: But what are you holding? Looking at the container, it looks like it was brought in from Cali... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like to know?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You know, you know. Isn’t this Kali’s traditional liquor? I had a trip to Cali a long time ago and I remember being treated well.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Did Mediah send this? I said it was the last time I drank it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Jiscard about the process of making traditional liquor.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Medea had a plan. Considering that I gave the recipe to Ren... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I guess he asked Ren with the hope that new fruits of hope would bloom in Avalon as well.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Now, give it to me.
(Giscard cannot hide his joy after receiving the traditional Kali liquor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought you would like it this much... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's that precious. It has a deep flavor thanks to precious fruits and long aging.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It had to be aged, but maybe this was made too quickly?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: So, I think I may have taken a slightly shortcut. Originally, it was aged in the village... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: If it was made with energy from Lapier, it would probably have been discussed with Iris.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It smells good. I can't be the only one who drinks this good stuff... How about you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. It's a gift from Jiscard, so you can enjoy it alone.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Is that so?
(No sooner has Giscard finished speaking than he takes a glass out of his pocket and fills it with alcohol.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, why is the glass coming out of there?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Haha, pretend you didn’t see it. As expected, it's good. I can't be the only one who enjoys these good things. Let's all have fun with many people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Alcohol?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: We have a lot to do with the Kali people, not just alcohol. Medea thought the same thing.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The various forces in Eastland, including the Kali people, must work together to move forward for the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. That's good.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It worked out well. Hehe… . How long I've waited for this day to come... . ah… .
(Giscard makes a tearful expression for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: How long has it been since I felt like this? . It’s a feeling I haven’t felt in a long time… . There you are… . Are you busy now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. it's okay.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's nothing special, I just want to tell you a story from my old days. I thought you could tell me my story... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sounds fun.
(Giscard is grateful for %s's reaction and gathers firewood to make a fire. When preparations are complete, the scent of the alcohol that had been poured into a glass beforehand stimulates his past.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: When was the last time I went to Kali Village... . I remember the first time I met Medea.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yeah, hahaha. At that time, Medea looked at me with an expression as if there were people like this.
(In this way, Ziscard's story continues until night falls in Zisk's estate. The trust and faith the two had also deepens over that time.)
